scientific_integrity: Ordinary infinite divisibility is prior art and independently rederived as supporting context; the new result is the sharp thinning-innovation exclusion curve and its endpoint laws. Numerical checks corroborate, but do not replace, the analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: The sharp curve is necessary for the first-order one-count innovation obstruction; no sufficient thinning-self-decomposability classification below or at the curve is claimed. The originating 2024 infinite-divisibility paper was available only in indexed abstract form.
title: Sharp one-count innovation obstruction boundary for discrete Weibull thinning
